title: Homogeneous coordinate section of the projective twisting sheaf
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme, $N$ a finite index set and $P=\mathbf P(N;S)$ the projective space of [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change]. Let $p:P\to\operatorname{Proj}\mathbf Z[T_i:i\in N]$ be the projection to the integral model, and use the twisting sheaf $\mathcal O_P(1)$ of [def-pc-projective-space-twist]. For $i\in N$, define the homogeneous coordinate section $T_i:\mathcal O_P\to\mathcal O_P(1)$ as the pullback along $p$ of multiplication by the degree-one polynomial $T_i$, regarded as a map $\mathcal O\cong\mathcal O(0)\to\mathcal O(1)$ on the integral model, using the canonical unit identification for module pullback [def-pc-module-pullback].
